title: Composition of canonical continuous coefficient pullback maps
statement: Let $T$ be a topological commutative ring and $W\\xrightarrow{k} Z\\xrightarrow{h} X$ scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme]. Write $T_X(U)=C(|U|,T)$ for the ring sheaf [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-ring-functions-sheaf]. Define $c_h:h^{-1}T_X\\to T_Z$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] as the adjunct of precomposition by the first projection $U\\times_X Z\\to U$. Under the canonical inverse-image composition comparison, $c_{k\\circ h}$ equals $k^{-1}(c_h)$ followed by $c_k$. Coefficient postcomposition commutes with these pullback maps.

source.place: Bhatt--Scholze, Definition 6.8.1 and paragraph before Definition 6.8.6; composition of precomposition, transported through the inverse-image adjunction.

proof.text: Precomposition by the first projection is natural in the pro-etale test object, by the pullback lift-first-projection identity. Adjunction therefore defines the canonical pullback map and proves its section normalization.

In the iterated pullback, the first projection composed twice equals the first projection for composite base change, after the pullback-composition isomorphism. Evaluate each continuous function at this equality of scheme points to prove equality of the direct-image maps. Apply the adjunction hom-equivalence. Naturality of that equivalence and the unit identity for conjugate mates show that the adjunct of the direct-image composite is the inverse-image composite through the canonical comparison. This is the displayed composition equation. For a continuous coefficient ring map, postcomposition commutes pointwise with precomposition; naturality of the same adjunction gives coefficient naturality.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousCoefficientPullback_comp (T : Type (u + 1))
    [TopologicalSpace T] [CommRing T] [IsTopologicalRing T]
    {W Z X : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ X) :
    continuousCoefficientPullback T (k ≫ h) =
      (proEtaleRingInverseImageComp k h).hom.app (continuousCoefficientSheaf X T) ≫
        (proEtaleSheafInverseImage k CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map
          (continuousCoefficientPullback T h) ≫ continuousCoefficientPullback T k
